CLINICAL TRANSLATION: The primary endpoint was immune T-cell response, which was achieved with higher response rates in the combo arm (15/30 vs 10/30). POPULATION EFFECTS: No subgroup analyses reported. 5. CONFOUNDERS: This appears to be a Phase I/II immunogenicity study focused on immune response rather than clinical efficacy. The trial successfully demonstrated target engagement and pathway modulation, with some evidence of enhanced immune response in the combination arm, but lacks statistical rigor for definitive efficacy conclusions.
